entities.name: Mário Clemente Neto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mário Clemente Neto was a Brazilian Roman Catholic priest, prelate, and member of the Congregation of the Holy Spirit. Neto served as the Prelate of the Roman Catholic Territorial Prelature of Tefé, located in the Amazonian city of Tefé, from 15 December 1982 until his retirement on 19 October 2000.
